goal: Prevent narrow historical PASS receipts from silently defining the rebuilt N0 architecture or closure authority.
procedure: Enumerate previously qualified N0 stages, separate reusable causal evidence from runtime authority, create explicit historical-to-successor mappings, and default-deny old checkpoint/config/evaluator authority unless a successor proof requalifies the mechanism.
constraints: historical evidence remains preserved
no deletion of failed evidence
no old PASS can satisfy a new proof obligation
no gradient/GPU authorization from static review
decision_criteria: historical artifact cannot select or close successor model
authority: May classify and supersede process authority; may not promote a model or open sealed final evaluation.
failure_or_lesson: A clean narrow gate is not evidence that the architecture is sufficient for the full N0 objective. Treat past PASS as local evidence, not inherited authority.

goal: Replace fixed/narrow N0 assumptions with a dynamic full-envelope successor that preserves runtime schema flexibility and evidence-grounded execution.
procedure: Remove learned runtime identity axes and legacy structural dependencies; make relation/factor/view/slot/cardinality runtime axes; use exact sparse Binder support only after continuous semantics; make structured/fusion/latent operations permutation-safe and memory-bounded.
constraints: no learned relation-ID semantic authority
no fixed top-k semantic commitment
no product relation/factor/view/slot ceiling
Binder owns first exact structural sparsity boundary
authority: May redesign public N0 mechanics and tests; may not claim behavioral sufficiency from mechanics alone.
validation: Successor stack received exact-head gradient/no-ceiling tests plus streaming-attention and latent competition equivalence/causality tests.
failure_or_lesson: Scaling by merely increasing widths would preserve architectural defects. Runtime axes must be truly dynamic before capacity scaling is meaningful.

goal: Make relational execution semantics fail closed instead of passing narrow gates through accidental or averaged behavior.
procedure: Add explicit null support; enforce symmetric type/traversal invariance; propagate truncation; condition direction/modifiers and relation schema state per reasoning step; separate semantic activity from expected path length; centralize exact type compatibility; block unsupported or type-invalid graph evidence before fusion.
constraints: no support means no relational confidence
truncated program cannot claim completed execution
symmetric relation meaning cannot depend on stored endpoint order
step semantics cannot collapse to global averages
decision_criteria: counterfactual mechanics tests change only the intended variable
probability mass and survival contracts close exactly
authority: May repair mechanics and add proof obligations; may not lower gates or rerun failed science unchanged.
validation: Tests cover no-support, symmetry reversal, mixed direction, step-conditioned relation semantics, truncation, padded fields, type-invalid edges, inactive programs, and unsupported graph-view suppression.
failure_or_lesson: Several earlier components were locally green while still permitting unsupported evidence, averaged step semantics, or path-length confidence inflation. Causal intervention tests exposed these defects better than aggregate gates.

goal: Remove the hidden native-window product ceiling without pretending independent windows are globally semantic.
procedure: Keep token-lossless overlap ownership; add a trainable hierarchical cross-window segment bridge; require causal cross-window gradient/intervention tests; then route every text-bearing N0 surface through one shared virtualization policy rather than query-only handling.
constraints: no claim of dense unbounded native attention equivalence
all original content tokens owned once
padded segments/items inert
shared semantic backbone remains one gradient path
decision_criteria: distant segment can causally affect local token state
segment order equivariant with position metadata
authority: May remove hidden context ceilings and add trainable bridge; may not claim final long-context capability until runtime/training/final gates pass.
validation: Static suite checks token ownership, cross-window causal transfer, cross-window gradient, padded segment inertness, and per-surface virtualization receipts.
failure_or_lesson: Token-lossless segmentation is not semantic completeness. Query-only long-context support would also leave relation schemas, candidates, fields, and descriptors capped by the native encoder window.

goal: Ensure qualification and later optimization use one exact registered module topology instead of separately valid pieces assembled differently at train time.
procedure: Register the historical semantic model, shared backbone, cross-window semantic input, and successor stack under one module; route replay and full-envelope tasks through the same backbone; expose exact parameter accounting and per-surface virtualization receipts.
constraints: single shared backbone
no detached duplicate semantic encoder
same topology for CPU qualification, GPU dry run, and training
no optimizer ownership inside architecture
decision_criteria: final judgment gradient reaches backbone and bridge
replay and full-envelope update same backbone parameters
exact parameter report equals registered parameter sum
authority: May define the trainable public-N0 topology; optimizer/gradient execution on Magnolia remains unauthorized until runtime gates pass.
validation: Static tests prove end-to-end forward, final-judgment gradient to backbone/bridge, shared replay/full-envelope backbone, exact parameter accounting, and ceiling-free runtime axes.
failure_or_lesson: Individually green modules are insufficient if runtime qualification and training can assemble them differently. Topology identity itself must be governed.

goal: Replace self-referential representation success with independently labeled behavioral and evidence-grounded supervision.
procedure: Reserve natural relation families for train/dev/final; materialize bidirectional query/schema token evidence; compile behavioral rows into exact system batches; add multi-step causal chains and counterfactual/intervention masks; audit entity/template/split leakage before gradient.
constraints: sealed final families not used for tuning
natural benchmark separate from full sealed closure
token spans must align to exact tokenizer offsets
semantic factor labels describe behavior rather than only executor opcodes
decision_criteria: behavioral batch executes every causal path
counterfactuals may be absent without creating fake loss
authority: May create public N0 curriculum and DEV/static audit material; may not open sealed final for tuning or use private identity data.
validation: CI passes synthetic intervention audit, sealed natural relation audit, exact tokenizer evidence alignment, behavioral fabric leakage audit, and executable batch compilation.
failure_or_lesson: A model can satisfy representation losses without learning the intended judgment operation. Behavioral outcomes, evidence grounding, and causal interventions must be first-class targets.

goal: Make the exact multi-family training objective numerically stable, causally masked, and invariant to gradient accumulation topology before expensive training.
procedure: Wire operator/behavioral/replay/natural objectives into one contract; fail closed on any non-finite gradient; localize unstable components; replace SVD-sensitive anti-collapse gradient; fix masked irrelevant-view objective; separate loss-family EMA observation from microbatch gradient path and update EMA once per complete family observation.
constraints: no learned task-authority weights
inactive comparisons contribute zero
loss-family scaling cannot depend on microbatch partition
all critical trainable subsystems must receive finite gradient
decision_criteria: same effective loss scaling under equivalent microbatch partitions
authority: May repair objective math and static gradient behavior; no optimizer step or GPU training has been authorized.
validation: Latest exact-head CI run 35684768608 succeeded with 114 tests passed; proof matrix 99 obligations / 85 static obligations; synthetic intervention, sealed natural relation, historical authority firewall, full proof matrix, and CPU runtime contract static audit all passed.
failure_or_lesson: Forward-finite losses can still have non-finite gradients, and stateful loss normalization can make training behavior depend on accumulation topology. Backward behavior must be qualified explicitly before compute.
